rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a reflexive object or for emphasizing that she, rather than someone else, did or experienced something.

example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zing2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for deliberate or formal emphasis on her personal involvement or identity, rather than for an ordinary reflexive object.

example.english: This statement was issued by herself personally.
example.traditional: 呢份聲明係佢本人親自發表嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 sing1 ming4 hai6 keoi5 bun2 jan4 can1 zi6 faat3 biu2 ge3
